target_user_or_operator: Repository operator using Harness Ultragoal to deliver ambitious work with bounded supervision
job_to_be_done: Turn a falsifiable repository outcome into a reversible, inspectable, recoverable delivery using the smallest sufficient harness
context_of_use: Current-source Codex plugin and Rust CLI use in established dirty and materially different real repositories
desired_user_outcome: Reach a useful verified repository outcome while preserving unrelated work and understanding failures, recovery, evidence, and remaining claim limits
business_or_mission_outcome: Improve trustworthy delivery while reducing human attention, repeated review loops, and non-product proof or artifact cost
critical_journey_steps: install and identify exact installed bytes
observe host discovery in a new supported session
fit a real repository while preserving unrelated state
encounter and diagnose a representative failure
recover through parent-observed settlement and explicit cleanup
repeat useful work without stale custody or hidden writes
reconcile operator value, attention cost, retained artifacts, and claim ceiling
first_value_event: The installed current-source product safely completes one useful dirty-tree repository task and reports an honest same-surface outcome
accessibility_gate: Commands, decisions, failures, recovery actions, and claim limits remain text-first and inspectable without hidden visual-only state
cognitive_load_gate: One lean outcome contract, one canonical current state, batched reviews, and exact next actions minimize operator interpretation burden
recovery_burden_gate: Interruption and failure preserve unrelated state and expose diagnosis, parent-observed settlement, explicit cleanup, and repeat-use recovery
trust_burden_gate: Package, install, discovery, runtime, repository behavior, Product Fitness, release, and completion remain separate claims bound to exact identities
human_attention_policy: Use the lowest sufficient model and focused deterministic checks; request human judgment only for material product or authority decisions without a safe default
forbidden_substitutions: unit or fixture tests for real repository use
receipts, manifests, logs, signatures, or generated output for behavior
one repository journey for broad reuse or mastery
artifact existence for readiness, release, or completion
non_goal_product_claims: public marketplace availability before explicit release authority
universal operating-system or host support beyond exercised environments
broadly reusable or mastery-level performance before two materially different real-repository journeys
autonomous external publication or destructive cleanup
claim_ceiling: Contract authority only. N11 positive execution and CL-EVAL-IMPROVEMENT remain externally blocked; package, install, discovery, runtime, Product Fitness, real-repository journeys, readiness, release, completion, and mastery remain withheld pending exact same-surface evidence.
